name: Mostly Dry Torch
desc: Lights the way. Also your sleeve, if you get careless.

name: Spare Left Boot
desc: For when you lose exactly one boot. It happens.

name: Emergency Spoon
desc: Rated for soup, self-defense, and very slow tunneling.

name: Participation Ribbon
desc: You showed up. The bar was on the floor.

name: Jerky of Unknown Origin
desc: Restores a little health. Do not ask from what.

name: Nine-and-a-Half-Foot Pole
desc: Ten feet was over budget.

name: Stub of Chalk
desc: Mark your path. The monsters can read too.

name: Saucepan Helmet
desc: Protects your head. Mostly from rain.

name: Pebble of Encouragement
desc: Whispers "you got this." It is often wrong.

name: Suspiciously Lucky Die
desc: Rolls high when nobody's watching. Everybody's watching.

name: Grappling Umbrella
desc: Opens, hooks, climbs. Does not keep you dry.

name: Smoke Bomb, Slightly Used
desc: One big puff of smoke. Then a second, sadder puff.

name: Healing Juice Box
desc: Restores health. Comes with a tiny straw of dignity.

name: Honest Compass
desc: Points to treasure. Or to whatever it finds interesting.

name: Gecko Gloves
desc: Stick to walls. Also to everything else, forever.

name: Returning Sword
desc: Throw it. It comes back. Duck.

name: Mostly Invisible Cloak
desc: Hides everything except your feet and your fear.

name: Bottomless Belt Pouch
desc: Holds anything. Gives back most of it.

name: Laugh-Track Crown
desc: Every hit you land gets a round of canned laughter.

name: Dragon's Wisdom Tooth
desc: A dagger pulled from a very relieved dragon.

name: Sponsor-Grade Jetpack
desc: Flies for nine seconds. Ads play for thirty.

name: Hourglass of Time-Out
desc: Pause one fight. Everyone hates you, briefly.

name: The Golden Microphone
desc: Whatever you say next becomes the episode title.

name: Plot Armor
desc: You cannot die this episode. Ratings demand it.
